title: Sasha and Sticks
statementMd:
It's one more school day now. Sasha doesn't like classes and is always bored at them. So, each day he invents some game and plays in it alone or with friends.

Today he invented one simple game to play with Lena, with whom he shares a desk. The rules are simple. Sasha draws $*n*$ sticks in a row. After that the players take turns crossing out exactly $*k*$ sticks from left or right in each turn. Sasha moves first, because he is the inventor of the game. If there are less than $*k*$ sticks on the paper before some turn, the game ends. Sasha wins if he makes strictly more moves than Lena. Sasha wants to know the result of the game before playing, you are to help him.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *k* ≤ 10^{18}$, $*k* ≤ *n*$) — the number of sticks drawn by Sasha and the number $*k*$ — the number of sticks to be crossed out on each turn.

## Output

If Sasha wins, print "`YES`" (without quotes), otherwise print "`NO`" (without quotes).

You can print each letter in arbitrary case (upper of lower).

## Note

In the first example Sasha crosses out $1$ stick, and then there are no sticks. So Lena can't make a move, and Sasha wins.

In the second example Sasha crosses out $4$ sticks, then Lena crosses out $4$ sticks, and after that there are only $2$ sticks left. Sasha can't make a move. The players make equal number of moves, so Sasha doesn't win.
statementZhMd:
现在又到了一个上学日。萨沙不喜欢上课，总是觉得无聊。因此，每天他都会发明一些游戏，独自一人或和朋友一起玩。

今天，他发明了一个简单的游戏，准备和与他同桌的莉娜一起玩。游戏规则很简单。萨沙将 $*n*$ 根棍子画成一排。之后，玩家轮流行动，每次从左边或右边恰好划掉 $*k*$ 根棍子。因为萨沙是游戏的发明者，所以他先行动。如果在某次行动前纸上的棍子少于 $*k*$ 根，游戏结束。如果萨沙的行动次数严格多于莉娜，萨沙就获胜。萨沙想在游戏开始前知道结果，请你帮助他。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *k* ≤ 10^{18}$，$*k* ≤ *n*$）——萨沙画出的棍子数量，以及每次行动要划掉的棍子数量 $*k*$。

## 输出格式

如果萨沙获胜，输出 `YES`（不含引号），否则输出 `NO`（不含引号）。

每个字母均可任意使用大写或小写形式输出。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，萨沙划掉了 $1$ 根棍子，之后纸上就没有棍子了。因此莉娜无法行动，萨沙获胜。

在第二个样例中，萨沙划掉了 $4$ 根棍子，随后莉娜划掉了 $4$ 根棍子，此时只剩下 $2$ 根棍子。萨沙无法行动。两位玩家的行动次数相同，因此萨沙没有获胜。
